summary: Tested new promo code feature (ATFTEST95, 95% off). Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass — GET /api/promo/validate returns correct valid/percent_off for upper/lowercase codes, false for unknown; POST /api/orders/create with promo produces amount_czk=25 (qty1) and 50 (qty2), mode=teya, session_token present; invalid promo → HTTP 400 'Invalid discount code'; no-promo regression → 499. Frontend: /tickets checkout modal accepts ATFTEST95 via checkout-promo-input + checkout-promo-apply, shows promo-applied-note 'Code ATFTEST95 applied: −95% (list price 499 Kč)', pay button updates to 'CONTINUE TO PAYMENT — 25 KČ', embedded Teya form mounts (teya-embedded-checkout) with header '1ST RELEASE — 25 KČ' and inner 'Zaplatit 25,00 Kč' button (verified visually, no card entered). No-promo regression shows 499 Kč in modal + Teya. Invalid code shows 'Invalid discount code' toast and does not modify total.

minor.issue: Response does not echo unit_price_czk / list_price_czk / discount_percent (they are persisted on the order document but not returned). amount_czk alone is returned. Consider including them in response for client transparency and easier verification.

issues: React hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from emergent x-file dev overlay wrappers inside the quantity <select>. Benign in production but pollutes console — consider stripping x-file wrappers from <option> children.

action_items: (Optional) Return unit_price_czk, list_price_czk, discount_percent in POST /api/orders/create response
(Optional) Suppress hydration warning from emergent x-file wrapper inside <option> tags
critical_code_review_comments: Promo validation is applied server-side in create_order — good, promo cannot be spoofed from client.
unit_price uses max(1, round(...)) preventing 0 CZK abuse — good.
Teya session amount uses discounted total in minor units (amount_czk * 100) — verified via 25 KČ display in embedded Teya form.
Sold-out / gating: not explicitly re-tested via UI in this run, but code path applies promo AFTER standard tier/quantity checks in create_order, so gating is not bypassed (implicit).
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds promo_codes: ATFTEST95 (95% off, active) on startup — confirmed working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Promo endpoint uses upper-case normalization; buyer field names in POST /api/orders/create are 'name' and 'email' (not buyer_name/buyer_email).
